decisions.reason: As a small accessory with lower sunk investment and weaker strategic centrality than full trailer lines, it is the easiest offering for management to let go despite having kept it visible at launch.
A multi-model box trailer series shown on the home page represents a visible and resource-intensive commitment in a core category, which strongly favors persistence.

The car transporter line required meaningful development and fits the firm's transport-equipment identity, so management is likely to continue it and interpret any weak uptake as temporary niche-market variation.
The low-bed trailer series was prominently presented and sits close to the firm's main competence in practical hauling solutions, making withdrawal unlikely under escalation of commitment.
Although a cover series is somewhat less central than a full trailer platform, its home-page promotion and complementarity with the trailer business make management inclined to retain it.
Another box trailer series implies sunk development, stocked variants, and dealer-facing commitment in a core segment, so management would more likely keep it than admit overextension.
